speaker: A3G0C37OZR4C2Q
text: Hello.

speaker: A223BBAD3U6QFR
text: Hi

speaker: A3G0C37OZR4C2Q
text: Have you heard of Save the Children?

speaker: A223BBAD3U6QFR
text: Yes I have

speaker: A3G0C37OZR4C2Q
text: Good. It's a very strong and important organization. The lack of child support in developing countries, such as in Syria, has been growing for years now.

speaker: A223BBAD3U6QFR
text: Does this organization help people in the USA?

speaker: A3G0C37OZR4C2Q
text: No, they assist children in war zones. In Syria, in 2018 alone, 1,000 children were reported to be killed of injured due to rising violence.

speaker: A223BBAD3U6QFR
text: How much of the proceeds go directly towards the children?

speaker: A3G0C37OZR4C2Q
text: For every dollar donated, they receive 77 cents. It's a higher rate than most charities, because while we want most of the money to go to the children, there also needs to be some paid employees, although most are volunteers. Would you be interested in saving a child's life today?

speaker: A223BBAD3U6QFR
text: No, thank you.

speaker: A3G0C37OZR4C2Q
text: Are you sure? How many dollars do you spend everyday on pointless or unnecessary items, such as a candy bar or fast food?

speaker: A223BBAD3U6QFR
text: I'm sure. I work hard for money so I spend it the way I want.

speaker: A3G0C37OZR4C2Q
text: These children have no way of earning money, as their countries are in shambles. Many die of hunger or preventable disease, up 5.6 million per year. Even 50 cents makes all the difference.

speaker: A223BBAD3U6QFR
text: I'm not interested in this charity.

speaker: A3G0C37OZR4C2Q
text: Are you from the US?

speaker: A223BBAD3U6QFR
text: Yes I am

speaker: A3G0C37OZR4C2Q
text: Are you aware of the US bombing civilian cities in developing countries? Killing innocent children for no reason at all?

speaker: A223BBAD3U6QFR
text: Yes I am but I am not interested in this charity.

speaker: A3G0C37OZR4C2Q
text: It also helps children in Europe. France, Germany, Sweden. The refugee crisis has caused many children in such countries to be without basic necessities. Even the children who were originally from Europe.

speaker: A223BBAD3U6QFR
text: It's a terrible situation however I only donate to American charities.
